name: Home
description: EXP-011 §78 fixture: a Global Store "app" declares title "Untitled"; a text input feeds a Set Global Store on title, written by a Save button, and a Subscribe on title shows it. A State History records the store (Max History 20) and shows History Size, Current Index and Can Undo in three Texts, with a Clear History button. An Undo / Redo drives it: Undo, Redo, and Back to start (Jump To, Target Index 0); its Error is a fourth Text. The Checkpoint placed below holds a State Snapshot of the same store, so the history and the checkpoints are reached from two components by the store alone.
